definition: Per campaign/model, arithmetic mean of absolute window-total scenario-cost prediction error. Bridge/E2 include all technically accepted cells including deadline failures and anchors; E3 includes all 24 policy cells and excludes the two anchors. Repeats are repeated comparisons, not independent predictions.
scope: Fixed-record arithmetic for separately analyzed campaigns; no pooling.

old_bridge_metric.population: both replay and physical P1+ only
